within the model, the predicted loop widths of the pristine and twisted samples are comparable, so the model does not account for the presence/absence of hysteresis.

notes: C3 and C10 are judged not raised because they request specific measurements (a local strain map and minor loops at position 3) that the review does not ask for, even though the review raises the underlying physical concerns about strain (C2) and non-monodomain switching (C15, C11). C17 is judged partly raised by P12, which flags the 52% increase in extracted c-axis anisotropy h_y that directly reflects the higher c-axis saturation field in the twisted sample.
